name: Pain Coral
disable: DC 33 Nature check or DC 37 Occultism check or DC 37 Thievery check to pinpoint and disable key synaptic nerves throughout the coral, DC 37 Religion check to quell the coral's tortured memories; each success reduces the coral's number of actions per turn by 1, and the hazard is disabled when after four successes.
reset: The coral diffuses and resets after 1 minute.
routine: (4 actions) The coral casts Phantom Pain as a 6th-rank spell on a target (DC 33), targeting creatures that aren't already taking persistent mental damage.

items.name: Surge of Pain
items.text:
Trigger A creature takes damage within area D4

---
Effect The brain coral casts Spirit Link on Xendra. The hazard rolls initiative.

items.name: Share the Sadism
items.text:
Trigger A creature within 30 feet of the coral takes persistent mental damage

---
Effect The coral grants an equal number of temporary Hit Points to a different creature within 30 feet.

text: Haunted coral transfers pain between creatures.
